basis: The printing heads this gloss 'VERS. 6.' and it opens 'Vers. 6. Judicavit mihi Dominus. Id est, judicium mihi fecit, aequans me cum sorore mea.'. The chapter is Migne's caput, carried from the last one the printing states, and the lemma raises nothing against it.
date_basis: Remigius taught at Reims and then at Paris and died about 908. His scriptural commentaries are products of that teaching and are not separately dated; the range covers the years in which he taught. The date is the writing, not Migne's 1853 printing.
text: Vers. 6. Judicavit mihi Dominus. Id est, judicium mihi fecit, aequans me cum sorore mea. Idcirco vocavit nomen ejus Dan, id est judicium.
